composition: Twin-towered church of St. Peter and Paul above Lake Sarnen · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Sarnen, capital of Obwalden, is marked by the baroque church of St. Peter and Paul at Kirchhofen, a double-towered front with domed caps on a stair above Lake Sarnen. Kirchhofen is a quarter of Sarnen, west of the village square and the cantonal Rathaus. The church is not the high summit of Titlis and not the shore at Lungern. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast, with no rain.
